mentions.name: mcpmon
mentions.description: Monitoring software for remote MCP servers. It lets developers track uptime, stay aware of security concerns while developing and deploying their MCP servers, and share public status pages so users can see whether a server is up and safe.
mentions.problem: Developers lack visibility into the uptime and potential security concerns of remote MCP servers as they develop and deploy them.
mentions.audience: Developers building and deploying remote MCP servers
mentions.source_excerpt:
Monitoring software for remote MCP servers! Allows developers to monitor uptime and be aware of any security concerns as they continue to develop and deploy their MCP servers.

Easily share status pages with users so they know the status of your server and if it is safe or not!
